name: Zedekiah
title: False Prophet in the Divided Kingdom of Israel
summary: Zedekiah, son of Kenaanah (also known as Zedekiah, son of Kenaanah), was a false prophet who served under King Ahab of Israel. He is best known for his confrontation with the prophet Micaiah, son of Imlah, where he falsely prophesied victory in the war against Ramoth Gilead. He struck Micaiah on the cheek and challenged his prophetic authority.

keyEvents.title: False Prophecy of Victory at Ramoth Gilead
keyEvents.description: Zedekiah, son of Kenaanah, made iron horns and falsely prophesied that King Ahab would defeat the Arameans at Ramoth Gilead. He acted as the leader among the four hundred prophets who gave King Ahab a false message of victory.

keyEvents.title: The Unified Message of the Four Hundred Prophets
keyEvents.description: Zedekiah, son of Kenaanah, was among the four hundred prophets who unanimously urged King Ahab and King Jehoshaphat to march against Ramoth Gilead, promising them victory from the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Confrontation with the Prophet Micaiah
keyEvents.description: When the prophet Micaiah, son of Imlah, prophesied that Ahab would fall in battle, Zedekiah, son of Kenaanah, struck Micaiah on the cheek and challenged his prophetic authority by asking how the Spirit of the Lord had departed from him.

keyEvents.title: Micaiah's Judgment Against Zedekiah
keyEvents.description: Micaiah told Zedekiah that he would see the truth on the day he had to flee and hide in an innermost room. This was a prophecy that Zedekiah's false message would be exposed.

keyEvents.title: The Parallel Account in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The same event involving Zedekiah, son of Kenaanah, and his confrontation with Micaiah is also recorded in 2 Chronicles, confirming the importance of this account in Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: Ahab's Fall Confirms Micaiah's Prophecy
keyEvents.description: King Ahab's death in the battle at Ramoth Gilead confirmed that Micaiah had spoken truly and that Zedekiah, son of Kenaanah, was a false prophet who led the king to destruction.
